content.text: Migration finished with four DPCT warnings, all in the CUDA error-check and event code. Next I'll read the migrated source to see what needs cleaning up.
The migrated file still carries dpct helpers and a fake `CUDA_CHECK`, so I'm rewriting it as plain SYCL: a USM queue with profiling, a 1-D `parallel_for`, and events for timing.

limitations: A successful compile says nothing about numerical correctness; run verify.

input.summary: Ported fuzz.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/fuzz.dp.cpp. The file has no dpct:: helpers, DPCT_* macros, or <dpct/...> includes. It compiles with icpx -fsycl (add_dpct_include=false, 0 warnings) to build/candidate. The port uses a profiling sycl::queue, USM malloc_device/memcpy/free, a 1-D parallel_for over n with out[i] = norm * sycl::tanh(drive * in[i]), and event profiling for kernel_ms. I did not run the binary against the C++ reference, so the -96 dBFS null is unverified; no run/verify tool is available in this session. The CUDA error-check macro was dropped because SYCL reports errors via exceptions.
